d: There's more than motorcycle building happening at Orange County Choppers! While the crew works on a custom I Love Lucy tribute bike, a professional magician arrives at the garage with tricks that leave Mikey fascinated and Paul Sr. scratching his head. Between the laughs and illusions, Paul Jr. continues shaping a vintage-inspired chopper with distinctive heart details and portraits of Lucille Ball and Desi Arnaz. Experience a different kind of OCC entertainment in this American Chopper episode, where custom motorcycle builds meet unexpected magic. Watch American Chopper Season 2 Episode…
